messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Was unable to install Shiny using the existing Devtools package?
parts:
Seems like the problem is with libcurl (or lack of it on the system).
On Ubuntu you need to run something like this:

sudo apt-get install libcurl4-gnutls-dev

Then RCurl and other dependencies could be installed.
